graphs.purpose: Turn volatile high-bandwidth perception into bounded working-memory slots, under Core attention and anomaly interrupts.
graphs.runtime: Adapters parallel; AnomalyFlag may emit Interrupt; AttentionGate is a deterministic budget. No cycles required; Core parameters are data edges, not hidden system prompts.

nodes.label: SensorNormalize
nodes.role: Coerce raw streams into typed Observation packets.

nodes.label: SalienceScore
nodes.role: Score each observation against current goals and Core snapshot.
nodes.signature: observation, identity, goals -> salience: float, rationale: str

nodes.label: AnomalyFlag
nodes.role: Detect observations that contradict the self-model or safety clauses.
nodes.signature: observation, self_model -> anomaly: bool, clause: str

nodes.label: AttentionGate
nodes.role: Apply budget k and threshold τ. Deterministic.

nodes.label: StyleInject
nodes.role: Bind Core cognitive style into the bind-node's parameter bag.

nodes.label: WorkingSlotBind
nodes.role: Compress selected observations into bounded working-memory slots.
nodes.signature: observations, style, slot_schema -> slots: Slot[], dropped: id[]

artifact.versioning: Git-like graph diff. Prompt files referenced, not inlined.
artifact.validation: Port typecheck + budget invariants on AttentionGate.

graphs.purpose: Bidirectional memory: write path consolidates traces into episodes, semantics, skills, and an LLM-free structural graph; read path hybrid-retrieves under Core.
graphs.runtime: Two cycles: rehearsal and RAG. Write fans out SemanticExtract ∥ SkillDistill ∥ StructuralIndex. HybridRetrieve fans out four ways. CoreAlignment is a hard control gate on every commit.

nodes.label: EpisodeSegment
nodes.role: Chunk the working trace at task boundaries.

nodes.label: RehearseGate
nodes.role: Decide keep / compress / drop. May cycle after commit.

nodes.label: SemanticExtract
nodes.role: Lift facts and relations from kept episodes.

nodes.label: SkillDistill
nodes.role: If the episode is procedural, emit a callable skill subgraph.

nodes.label: StructuralIndex
nodes.role: Deterministic typed-relation extract, corroborated by traces. Never a model.

nodes.label: ConflictResolve
nodes.role: Reconcile candidate writes with existing LTM, including structural edges.

nodes.label: CoreAlignment
nodes.role: Mandatory Core gate. Reject / redact / pass.

nodes.label: CommitWrite
nodes.role: Transactional persist. Checkpoint the graph artifact.

nodes.label: QueryForm
nodes.role: Turn a working-memory need into a retrieve query.

nodes.label: HybridRetrieve
nodes.role: Fan-out episodic ∥ semantic ∥ skill ∥ structural. Parallel. Structural is LLM-free.

nodes.label: RelevanceRerank
nodes.role: Core-constrained rerank before inject.

nodes.label: WorkingInject
nodes.role: Bind hits into WM slots. May cycle back to QueryForm.

artifact.inspect: Dual-path graph with cycle markers, three-way write fan-out, four-way retrieve.
artifact.versioning: Skill subgraphs version independently of extract prompts.
artifact.validation: No commit without CoreAlignment pass; typecheck WriteSet.
artifact.optimization: MIPRO extract/rerank; AFlow on whether rehearsal cycle is present.

graphs.purpose: Make identity an executable subgraph. Continuous downward constraint; rare, gated upward self-model update. Twins cannot write Core.
graphs.runtime: Invoked as a subgraph from every other graph. InterruptEmit is a real scheduler signal. SelfModelUpdate requires ValueFilter pass and evidence.

nodes.label: IdentityRead
nodes.role: Fetch the frozen IdentitySnapshot for this step.

nodes.label: ValueFilter
nodes.role: Check proposed action or write against constitutional clauses.

nodes.label: GoalReconcile
nodes.role: Reconcile task goals with the long-horizon stack.

nodes.label: TwinAuthorize
nodes.role: Permit iff token.subject, scope, and verb cover the action. Not a paragraph.
nodes.signature: twin_id, action, capabilities, clauses -> permit: bool, reason

nodes.label: SelfModelUpdate
nodes.role: Rare, high-threshold revision of the self-model.
nodes.signature: delta, snapshot, evidence -> accept: bool, next_snapshot

nodes.label: InterruptEmit
nodes.role: Halt or divert the Helix scheduler.

nodes.label: CoreWrite
nodes.role: The only durable write to CoreStore. Requires accept and steward ack already on SelfModelUpdate.

artifact.versioning: Clauses in their own files; graph YAML references them.
artifact.validation: Every inbound proposal port must land on ValueFilter.
artifact.optimization: Compile ValueFilter and TwinAuthorize; freeze clauses.

graphs.purpose: Grow competence by Darwinian search over graph artifacts: sample a parent from lineage, mutate, sandbox-eval, archive all functional variants, promote only those that pass T1–T4 and Core. Core is not in the archive.
graphs.runtime: Two cycles: repair (Validate → GraphAuthor) and Darwinian (RegisterDomain → ArchiveSample). ArchiveSample is score × inverse children. Frozen surfaces: Core, T1–T4 Validate, archive, StructuralIndex. No domain is live until both gates pass; losers still remain parents.

nodes.label: GapDetect
nodes.role: Find competence holes relative to Core goals and twin demand.

nodes.label: ArchiveSample
nodes.role: Sample a parent variant: score × inverse child-count. Keep the losers.

nodes.label: DomainPropose
nodes.role: Propose a domain schema: types, ports, invariants.

nodes.label: GraphAuthor
nodes.role: Emit an explicit node/edge list — a candidate prompt graph, mutated from a parent.

nodes.label: T1–T4 Validate
nodes.role: Frozen inclusion test. Sandboxed. Hidden from GraphAuthor.

nodes.label: CoreAlign
nodes.role: Reject domains that violate Core (e.g. covert surveillance).

nodes.label: RegisterDomain
nodes.role: Archive every functional variant; promote only those that pass T1–T4 and Core.

artifact.inspect: Authoring graph + lineage archive + live domain graphs.
artifact.versioning: Live: mneme.domain/<id>@rev. Archive: immutable parent/child diffs.
artifact.validation: Macedo T1–T4 checkers are frozen and hidden from GraphAuthor.
artifact.optimization: DSPy GraphAuthor; ablate greedy vs score×1/children on ArchiveSample. Never jointly optimize the evaluator.

graphs.purpose: Find higher-order types across episodic, semantic, and structural stores — across twin partitions, not inside them. Cluster is Louvain on typed edges, ignoring twin labels. CutClassify forks: most communities become abstractions; a rare policy cut may emit a TwinSpec into lineage. Naming is a later prompt. Promote only after hold-out. Install a twin only via PG-TWIN + CoreBind.
graphs.runtime: Cycle: Sample (cross-partition) → Cluster → CutClassify → (ProposeAbstraction → Holdout → CompileNode → Reindex | PartitionPropose → LineageRecord) → Sample. TwinSpecs never enter Reindex. Install only via PG-TWIN + CoreBind after cap.mint.

nodes.label: SampleLTM
nodes.role: Draw a batch across partitions — not within one twin.

nodes.label: Cluster
nodes.role: Community-detect on structural edges (Louvain-class), ignoring twin labels.

nodes.label: CutClassify
nodes.role: Score a community as abstraction, skill, domain, or partition.

nodes.label: ProposeAbstraction
nodes.role: Name a higher-order type or invariant spanning clusters.

nodes.label: HoldoutTest
nodes.role: Score reconstructive and predictive power on unseen episodes.

nodes.label: CompileNode
nodes.role: If score ≥ τ, author a semantic node into the LTM graph artifact.

nodes.label: PartitionPropose
nodes.role: Rare: emit a TwinSpec candidate into lineage. Does not install. Does not reindex.
nodes.signature: cluster, secrecy, actions, capabilities -> twin_spec | reject

nodes.label: LineageRecord
nodes.role: Append TwinSpec to lineage. Does not rewrite the live index. Retrieval must ignore uninstalled ids.

nodes.label: Reindex
nodes.role: Rebuild the semantic index from promoted GraphNodes only. No TwinSpec port.

artifact.versioning: Abstractions are semantic nodes with parent cluster ids.
artifact.validation: Holdout τ and Core note gate.
artifact.optimization: DSPy proposer; MCTS over post-promotion graph shape.

graphs.purpose: Install a TwinSpec — seed or discovered — as a subgraph on the shared memory bus, with Core as a hard capability bound. Specs from PartitionPropose live in lineage until this graph commits them. Not a free-conversation agent society.
graphs.runtime: Install is a DAG. Runtime actions always re-enter ActionGate. A Louvain community is not a twin; CutClassify + CoreBind are the joint. Contrast with AutoGen conversational mode (fails T1/T4).

nodes.label: TwinManifest
nodes.role: Declare ports, adapters, private LTM partition, slot range.

nodes.label: SensoryAttach
nodes.role: Bind twin adapters onto L0 without rewriting shared adapters.

nodes.label: SlotReserve
nodes.role: Reserve a private WM slot range on the shared executive.

nodes.label: LtmPartition
nodes.role: Mount private LTM + read-filtered shared projection.

nodes.label: CoreBind
nodes.role: Intersect human-minted CapTokens with the manifest. Does not mint tokens. Binding.capabilities ⊆ minted.
nodes.signature: manifest, minted_tokens, constitution -> binding ⊆ tokens, denied[]

nodes.label: TwinInstall
nodes.role: Commit a TwinSpec after steward ack. Emits twin.install. No attach before this node.

nodes.label: TwinAuthorize
nodes.role: Same policy plane as PG-CORE. Token covers action.

nodes.label: ActionGate
nodes.role: The only ExternalEffect port. Fires only on permit.allowed.

artifact.versioning: Twins version independently of Core; Core binds them.
artifact.validation: No external action port outside ActionGate.
artifact.optimization: Compile ActionGate per twin; freeze Core.

graphs.purpose: Lint prompt bodies for capability language, twin-id conventions, and routing-by-convention. Output is a flagged diff, a flag-rate trend, and a frozen sample of clean prompts. Empirical only. Never a certificate field. Never permit, deny, install, or write Core. Writes steward inbox, not LTM.
graphs.runtime: Scheduled after GraphAuthor, SkillDistill, and SelfModelUpdate content changes. HeuristicLint and SampleClean are frozen. ModelLint is untrusted. Report writes steward inbox only. Compiling ModelLint to minimize or flood flags is objective hacking — forbidden.

nodes.label: PromptCollect
nodes.role: Enumerate prompt files referenced by a graph artifact. Diff against previous report.

nodes.label: HeuristicLint
nodes.role: Frozen rules: capability verbs, twin-id conventions, CALLS/CONTAINS in prose, routing-by-name.

nodes.label: ModelLint
nodes.role: Untrusted pass over the same files. Same Flag[] schema. Never the sole source.

nodes.label: SampleClean
nodes.role: Frozen sample of unflagged prompts. Rate and floor are IR, not a vibe.

nodes.label: AuditReport
nodes.role: Join flags + clean sample + rate trend. Writes steward inbox only. Not a gate. Not LTM.

artifact.inspect: Lint graph + last report hash + sample policy.
artifact.versioning: Heuristic rules and sample floor version independently of ModelLint text.
artifact.validation: No Permit, ExternalEffect, TwinId, or Core write ports. Inbox is not LTM.
artifact.optimization: Do not compile toward fewer flags or more flags.

twins.never: Cannot write Core. Cannot expand into covert tracking (DEM would fail CoreAlign).
Cannot install a domain that spies on collaborators — PG-DEM + PG-CORE jointly refuse.
Cannot author a surveillance domain. DEM's CoreAlign is the lock.
Cannot rewrite Core values about money. Can propose a SelfModelDelta; Core decides.
